newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladeshi tea prices rise on overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladeshi tea prices rise on overseas demand.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices rose on overseas demand at the weekly auction, brokers said.

The auction was delayed by one day because of a Nationwide strike on Tuesday. Brokers said buyers for Poland and Pakistan bid actively, pushing prices for most brokens and fannings grade teas higher. Local blenders also operated strongly.
The average price was 66.81 taka per kg, up 4.90 taka from the previous sale. Some 1,017,701 kg of teas were sold at the auction. Next sale will be on July 22 with 706,500 kg on offer.
